title: 多稼如云正宇 Duojia Ruyun zhengyu
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.7 m, eave 4.4 m, ridge 7.73 m above the ground
hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 5 bays, the middle widest, a porch front and back, steps on the back, front, 歇山 hip-and-gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 多稼如云
evidence.excerpt_zh: 濓溪樂處迤北對河外稻塍者為多稼如雲正宇五楹前宇為芰荷香正宇東稍南有室為湛緑（圓明園册）臣等謹按多稼如雲四十景之一軒額興芰荷香湛緑皆御書
evidence.summary: North of 濓溪樂處, facing paddies across the stream: 多稼如雲, a five-bay main range, 芰荷香 in front and 湛緑 to the east.
